testdata/vectors/ is generated by contrib/norn-ref (the Python reference implementation) via `make vectors`.
Go tests read these files; they are the cross-implementation contract (SPEC.md §12).

## `anchors/`

`sample.ots` is an OpenTimestamps detached timestamp written by
**`python-opentimestamps`**, the reference implementation — not by either of
Norn's. It is here for the reason the rest of this suite exists: a parser
checked only against its own writer agrees with itself and with nobody.

It is over `sha256("norn checkpoint at size 90")` and carries two branches from
that digest — one attested in a Bitcoin block, one still pending at a calendar
— which is the shape a real proof has. Nothing regenerates it.
